name: Verify a web source
short_description: Check a web page's author, date, evidence, and corroboration before using one claim.
self_assessment: I can verify one web claim with four source checks without help.
description: Check a web page's author, date, evidence, and corroboration before using one claim. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Verify a claim before sharing it
